item.name: Chunked uploads
item.description: Uploading files over 50 MB in 5 MB pieces.

description.content:
For files over 50 MB (up to 2 GB). The response says how big each chunk must be and how many
to send. Send every chunk to `POST /uploads/{upload}/chunks/{index}`, then call
`POST /uploads/{upload}/complete`. Unfinished uploads expire after 24 hours.
(Required)

Chunks can be sent in any order and resent. Every chunk must be exactly `chunk_size` bytes, except the last, which holds the remainder.

REST API for the task management platform (Laravel 13).

**Authentication.** Call `POST /auth/login` to get a JWT, then send it on every other request as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens live for 60 minutes (`JWT_TTL`). `POST /auth/logout`
blacklists the token.

**Errors.** All errors are JSON with a `message`. Validation failures (422) also carry an `errors`
object keyed by field, each holding a list of messages.

**Real-time.** Changes are broadcast over Laravel Reverb (Pusher protocol). Private channels are
authorized through `POST /broadcasting/auth`. See `documentation/architecture.md` for the channels
and event payloads.
